title: BE persists INVOICING view without See Financial Data (fin-data dependency NOT cascaded server-side)
steps:
1. POST /api/roles with fe_permissions=['invoicingPaymentsView'] and cross_toggles.seeFinancialData=false (note: seeFinancialData is a CROSS_TOGGLE boolean, not an fePermission id).
2. Inspect the response status and body.
3. GET /api/roles/{id} for the returned role id and inspect the persisted fe_permissions AND cross_toggles.
expected:
1. The API returns 201 Created.
2. seeFinancialData is NOT auto-added: it stays false. No cascade occurs and no 400 is returned.
3. Fetching the role back shows the bundle persisted VERBATIM (invoicingPaymentsView only; cross_toggles.seeFinancialData=false).
NOTE: Unlike the Work-Order CRUD parent chain (which the backend DOES cascade), the See-Financial-Data dependency for Invoicing is a FRONT-END display gate only - it is NOT cascaded or enforced server-side. Verified live on staging 2026-07-09 (POST 201, seeFinancialData persisted false).
